fields.name: nsrEpoch
fields.description: The epoch from which this NSR value is coming from.

fields.name: nsrOverrideBid
fields.description: This signal is used to unconditionally override NSR as a bid in Q*. Should only be used in case of emergency. To have any effect, the value should be present and greater than 0.001.

fields.name: priorAdjustedNsr
fields.description: NSR - prior. Estimate of whether the site is above/below average NSR in its slice.

fields.name: nsrDataFromFallbackPatternKey
fields.description: If true indicates that we do not have NSR data computed for the chunk, and instead the data is coming from an average of other host chunks.

fields.name: vlqNsr
fields.description: NSR from a headroom model targeting low-quality video sites.

fields.name: siteLinkIn
fields.description: Average value of the site_link_in for pages in the sitechunk.

fields.name: siteLinkOut
fields.description: Aggregated value of url link out scores for this sitechunk.

fields.name: site2vecEmbedding
fields.description: Site2vec embeddings.

fields.name: site2vecEmbeddingEncoded
fields.description: Encoded site2vec embedding (to be used in superroot) since the full embeddings take too much space.

fields.name: siteChunk
fields.description: Primary NSR sitechunk. In most cases same as HOST_LEVEL_V3 sitechunked canonical url. In rare but important cases based on page markup.

fields.name: siteChunkSource
fields.description: These are only annotated in the Goldmine NSR annotator.

fields.name: secondarySiteChunk
fields.description: Secondary NSR sitechunk. When present, provides more granular chunking than primary sitechunks.

fields.name: clusterId
fields.description: An id for defining clusters of sites. Used in ecosystem experiments (project Tundra).

fields.name: chromeInTotal
fields.description: Site-level Chrome views.

fields.name: impressions
fields.description: Site-level impressions.

fields.name: titlematchScore
fields.description: Titlematch score of the site, a signal that tells how well titles are matching user queries.

fields.name: healthScore
fields.description: Categorical signals.

fields.name: tofu
fields.description: Site-level tofu score: site quality predictor based on content.

fields.name: vlq
fields.description: Score of the Video LQ model.

fields.name: articleScore
fields.description: Score from article classification of the site.

fields.name: chardEncoded
fields.description: Site-level chard score: site quality predictor based on content.

fields.name: chardScoreEncoded
fields.description: Site-level Chard (encoded as an int).

fields.name: chardScoreVariance
fields.description: Site-level Chard Variance for all pages of a site.

fields.name: clutterScore
fields.description: Delta site-level signal in Q* penalizing sites with a large number of distracting/annoying resources loaded by the site.

fields.name: i18nBucket
fields.description: Currently corresponds to i18n_g42_bucket.

fields.name: isCovidLocalAuthority
fields.description: Bit to determine whether the site has the local authority covid signal.

fields.name: isElectionAuthority
fields.description: Bit to determine whether the site has the election authority signal.

fields.name: isVideoFocusedSite
fields.description: Site is considered video-focused if it has >50% of URLs with watch pages (with smoothing prior).

fields.name: ketoVersionedData
fields.description: Keto data.

fields.name: localityScore
fields.description: Locality score of the site, i.e. the locality component of the LocalAuthority signal.

fields.name: pnav
fields.description: Fractional signals.

fields.name: pnavClicks
fields.description: denominator for the pnav computation

fields.name: racterScores
fields.description: Site-level AGC classification score.

fields.name: siteAutopilotScore
fields.description: Aggregated value of url autopilot scores for this sitechunk.

fields.name: siteQualityStddev
fields.description: Estimate of site's PQ rating stddev--spread of the page-level PQ ratings of a site. Different from nsr_variance which predicts error of NSR itself.

fields.name: smallPersonalSite
fields.description: Score of small personal site promotion.

fields.name: spambrainLavcScore
fields.description: The SpamBrain LAVC score, as of July 2022.

fields.name: versionedData
fields.description: Versioned map of NSR values for experimenting with the next release.
